verdict.rationale: Insomnia's evidence covers API design, testing, mocking, Git sync, and org-level sharing of collections/environments, but there is no mention of a discoverable catalog or developer portal that teams can browse to find and consume APIs. Organizations (insomnia-docs-12) only cover sharing collections among colleagues, not a searchable catalog/portal experience. missing for 10: any documented catalog/portal feature, API discovery UI, publishing workflow for a portal, or evidence of portal branding/customization.
